title: itembank write manifest
description: The strict write provenance, recovery, and undo contract of the Phase 11 transactional writer (D-15/D-16/D-17). One manifest is durably recorded before any mutation, names the locked backend (Git for tracked-clean targets, content-addressed shadow otherwise), declares every reversible unit, records before/after fingerprints, the diff, and full request/source/tool provenance, and is the only input one-step undo may route on. Callers never choose a backend or a restore mechanism (D-15, T-11-24).

schema_version.description: This document's own schema version; must equal x-itembank-version.

write_id.description: The deterministic write identity derived from request, bank-before, source, profile, and tool provenance; a duplicate write returns the existing result (AUTH-01/T-11-05).

run_id.description: The authoring run identity this write belongs to.

backend.description: The locked backend chosen by the writer for this exact target, never by a caller: shadow for non-Git targets, Git for tracked-clean worktree targets (D-15).

state.description: The durable writer state; a prepared manifest exists before any mutation, applied only after the after-fingerprint guard passes.

target_path.description: The absolute path of the mutated target.

units.description: The declared reversible units of this write, sorted and deduplicated (D-16).

before_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the exact before bytes; undo restores only these.

before_image.description: The content-addressed path of the durably recorded before-image.

before_exists.description: False for a newly created derived report artifact whose before-image is the empty state -- never a missing fingerprint (11-05).

after_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint the target must carry for undo to be allowed; any mismatch refuses without a force path (T-11-17).

request_fingerprint.description: The bounded request that produced this write (D-17).

source_fingerprints.description: Every source fingerprint the write cites, sorted and deduplicated.

tool_version.description: The tool version that produced the write, so a later run can detect a version mismatch (D-17).

diff.description: The reproducible unified diff this write applied (D-17).

created_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the prepared state.

applied_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the applied state; null while prepared.

git_commit.description: The machine-authored commit hash when the Git backend applied the write (D-15); null for shadow writes.
